player_facing: Rain spatters soot-dark stone across Cinderwatch's eastern gate while frayed banners snap above the muddy approach. A tavern runner weaves through the crush, calling offers of hot stew and paid rumor as the notice board waits beside the arch. The queue inches forward in fits, wagon wheels grinding through black ruts while wet canvas slaps against overloaded carts and the smell of damp wool, smoke, and sour road dust clings to everyone close enough to breathe on you. Somewhere ahead, a guard captain's voice cuts through the mutter of the crowd, sharp enough to make shoulders hunch and conversations die for a heartbeat before the pressure of bodies closes in again. Near the line, one threadbare watcher stands too still, eyes flicking to packs and faces instead of the arch. You can read the notice board, press the guards, approach the tavern runner, or watch the silent figure in the crush.
The missing patrol was last seen taking the northwest mud track past the crates.
You arrive at Old Milestone.
Faint overlapping prints mark the mud around the old milestone, but their number, origin, and direction stay unclear.
